title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-09-08
lineage: SBD> master reel> cassette> Dat >HD> shn

ai_review.summary: A top‑grade soundboard capture of the underrated 9‑8‑73 show, highlighted by blistering Eyes‑of‑the‑World jams, a soaring He's Gone and flawless Weather Report Suite.
ai_review.review: The recording is crystal‑clear for a 1973 soundboard tape, offering superb instrument separation with only a faint hint of distant horns. Musically the band is in peak form – Jerry’s articulate leads shine on Eyes and Let It Grow, Bobby and Phil lock into an unshakable groove, and the second set delivers a majestic Weather Report Suite and a standout GSET. Overall it’s a must‑listen performance that has long been overlooked.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews, the vast majority rate the show 4–5 stars and praise both performance and sound quality; only a few minor criticisms appear.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clean mix with excellent instrument separation; slight vintage coloration noted but no major drop‑outs. One reviewer mentions faint horns in the background on Let It Grow.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
poor_songs: Let Me Sing Your Blues Away
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set bursts out with a powerful Eyes jam, while the second half rolls through a superb Weather Report Suite and a fiery GSET, keeping a relaxed yet tight groove throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highly articulate guitar work; standout solos on Eyes, Let It Grow, and multiple improvisational moments.
band_member_comments.Phil: Locked in with Bobby for a deep, syncopated low‑end; solid bass foundation noted by several reviewers.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (bass) receives repeated praise for laying down a tight, driving groove that anchors the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's organ work shines—especially a Hancock‑style solo in Eyes—and his vocals are appreciated on several tracks.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy’s drumming is described as “locking down a tight groove” and providing the energetic pulse for the entire set.
